description: Run an internet speed test to measure download speed, upload speed, latency, and jitter. Results are saved to local history.

sustainTime.description: How long to sustain each download sample (1-8 seconds). Lower = faster but less accurate, higher = slower but more accurate. Default: 6

testTimeout.description: Overall wall clock cap for the whole test in seconds. 0 disables, below 30 raised to 30, above 1800 lowered to 1800. Default: 300

tests.description: Which tests to run. Default: all (latency, download, upload)

name: run_speed_test
